title: Can a neighbour lend a key?
hook: A shrinking leaf may need help from its sibling.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary search-tree ordering; subtree size and interval notation.
doesNotKnow: Preserve minimum occupancy during B-tree deletion by borrowing through the parent.

misconception: Deleting a B-tree key only removes it from a leaf.
objective: Preserve minimum occupancy during B-tree deletion by borrowing through the parent.

claims.text: A child with only the minimum number of keys needs a repair before deletion. Borrowing moves a parent separator down and a sibling boundary up, preserving both occupancy and sorted separation.
